security_audit.summary: Four findings confirm intentional curl execution for the RouteMux workflow. Other static alerts are harmless Markdown, expected provider URLs, or protected credential use. The submission template permits shell injection if user prompts are inserted without robust escaping.

remediation.issue: The submission command places prompt data inside a shell-quoted JSON template.
remediation.suggestion: Build request bodies with a structured JSON tool and pass them from a protected file or standard input. Never interpolate user text into shell commands.

content.value_statement: Video generation APIs require model selection, asynchronous polling, and careful download handling. This skill guides RouteMux submissions and returns completed video files with status details.
actual_capabilities: Queries the live RouteMux catalogue for video-capable models.
Submits text prompts as asynchronous video generation jobs.
Polls job status with a recommended 10-to-30-second backoff.
Downloads completed video content to a chosen MP4 path.
Reports billing, model, job, and expiration errors without automatic resubmission.
limitations: Requires a valid ROUTEMUX_API_KEY and available account credit.
Relies on RouteMux service availability and current model access.
Video generation can take several minutes.
Does not document source image parameters for image-to-video requests.

use_cases.title: Create Short Concept Clips
use_cases.description: Generate a short visual concept from a written scene and receive the downloaded MP4 path.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Motion
use_cases.description: Test an approved product animation prompt with a current video model before production.

use_cases.title: Validate Video API Workflows
use_cases.description: Submit one job, monitor asynchronous status, and inspect completion or provider errors.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-second video of [subject] in [setting]. Use a suitable RouteMux model and save the completed MP4 in [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Source Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image-to-video clip from [image path]. Add [motion], choose a suitable live model, and save the result in [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Models Before Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: List current video models supporting [requirement]. Compare documented capabilities, then ask me to approve one before submitting a job.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Multiple Approved Clips
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [clip count] approved clips from these prompts: [prompts]. Submit sequentially, poll with backoff, report each status, and never retry failed jobs.

output_examples.input: Generate a five-second clip of rain crossing a neon storefront.
output_examples.output: The video completed in four minutes. The MP4 is available at /workspace/videos/neon-rain.mp4.

output_examples.input: Check which current video model supports my requested format.
output: Available models were checked from the live RouteMux catalogue.
The selected model matches the documented video output requirement.
Approval is required before the billable submission.

output_examples.input: Explain why my submitted video did not complete.
output_examples.output: Job rmx-example failed with the provider message shown. It was not resubmitted, preventing another charge.

best_practices: Confirm the selected model before any unrequested billable submission.
Poll no faster than every ten seconds and increase the interval toward thirty seconds.
Keep the API key only in ROUTEMUX_API_KEY and exclude it from files, logs, and replies.
anti_patterns: Do not choose a model from memory when the live catalogue is available.
Do not submit multiple alternatives without explicit approval.
Do not automatically retry failed jobs because each submission can create another charge.

faq.question: What credential does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a RouteMux API key stored in the ROUTEMUX_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: How long does video generation take?
faq.answer: Generation usually takes minutes, and timing depends on the selected model and provider load.

faq.question: How does the skill choose a model?
faq.answer: It queries the live RouteMux catalogue and selects a video-capable model matching the request.

faq.question: Will failed jobs retry automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill reports the failure and avoids automatic retries because each submission may incur a charge.

faq.question: Where is the completed video saved?
faq.answer: The skill downloads completed content to an absolute MP4 path and reports that path.

faq.question: Can it create image-to-video clips?
faq.answer: The skill advertises image-to-video use, but its workflow does not document the required source image parameters.
